dish: 'Paris no Romance' — coffee poured over a floating rose-cream; also Turkish and Arabic coffee
n: Kōhī Sakan Inshallah, Kokusai-dōri (珈琲茶館インシャラー)
w: Coffee house on Kokusai-dōri trading since 1974, themed on Arabia as coffee's birthplace and serving Turkish and Arabic coffees. Its signature 'Paris no Romance' has rose cream swirling in the cup as the coffee is poured at the table.

dish: Okinawan home cooking and awamori ('Live & Okinawa ryōri') through live shima-uta sets by Nēnēs
n: Live House Shimauta, Kokusai-dōri (ライブハウス島唄)
address: Haisai Okinawa Bldg 3F, 1-2-31 Makishi, Naha, Okinawa
w: Home stage of Nēnēs, the women's vocal group credited with sparking the shima-uta boom; they play several nights a week (three sets a night), with other local acts on the rest. Okinawan food and drink served, no time limit on the live charge.
